name: Xin Point Holdings Limited
summary: Xin Point Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, manufactures and sells automotive and electronic components in China, North America, Europe, and internationally. The company offers automotive interior decorative components, such as LCD supporter, SW, console, IP, and DP decoration parts, seats parts, and inner door handles; and automotive exterior decorative components, including emblems, exterior door handles, decorative strip, wheel emblems, grills, and mirror decoration parts. It also provides ambient lights, door panel ambient lights, console ambient lights, and projection lights, as well as double-layer flexible copper clad laminate related products.
